item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00372","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C15","C05","C14"],"selected_candidate_label":"C15","confidence":0.97,"relationship_type":"literal_language_template","rationale":"C15 supplies a concrete appropriation-transmittal template: the same formal opening identifies supplemental estimates, fiscal year, amount, and recipient, followed by substantive justification and an almost identical closing incorporating the Bureau of the Budget Director's letter. C05 uses the same machinery but differs in singular number and wording; C14 is related but transmits a draft contract-authorization provision rather than supplemental appropriation estimates.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"I have the honor to transmit herewith for the consideration of the Congress supplemental estimates of appropriation for the fiscal year 1951 in the amount of $89,000,000 for the Department of State and the General Services Administration.","parent_excerpt":"I have the honor to transmit herewith for the consideration of the Congress supplemental estimates of appropriation in the amount of $2,434,441,000 for the fiscal year 1949 for the National Military Establishment, in the form of amendments to the Budget for the said fiscal year.","explanation":"The opening follows the same distinctive appropriation-transmittal formula and substitutes the new fiscal year, amount, and recipient agencies."},{"child_excerpt":"The details of these estimates are set forth in the letter of the Director of the Bureau of the Budget, transmitted herewith, in whose comments and observations thereon I Concur.","parent_excerpt":"The details of these estimates, the necessity therefor, and the reasons for their submission at this time are set forth in the letter of the Director of the Bureau of the Budget, transmitted herewith, in whose comments and observations thereon I concur.","explanation":"The child closely reproduces the parent's concluding incorporation of the Budget Director's accompanying letter, with only a shortened list of what that letter contains."}]}
